The '''5-Node Sensor''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array manufactured by [[Csoli-Corli]]. 5-Node Sensors were installed aboard the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].
